title: Mapping locally nondominated curves in multiobjective topology optimization of compliance and volume
summary: This paper studies the nondominated set for topology optimization of compliance and volume. In the multiobjective topology optimization literature, scalarization is a popular method to approximate this set, which is better known as the Pareto frontier. However, previous work indicates that the pointwise approximation obtained by scalarization obfuscates its underlying mathematical structure: under an imposed length scale, it consists of locally nondominated curve segments.
